release_handoff.integration_note: The new runtime is isolated behind model, stage-store, analysis-cache and telemetry protocols so the release workstream can bind kernel persistence without changing legacy report behavior.
risks: The kernel branch must provide the canonical Supabase-backed StageStore/AnalysisCache/telemetry bindings before production routing switches to this runtime; the included JSON stores are private durable local implementations, not the canonical ledger.
No live provider or public-network benchmark was run in this implementation worktree by contract; release must perform controlled benchmark and canary gates.
Website collection intentionally uses one pre-approved address and does not fail over across DNS answers, favoring SSRF determinism over availability.
